# Shared Source Entry

Embed the following block inside **References and original excerpts** in every
generated article. Repeat it for each distinct supporting passage, using unique
IDs consistent across the approved companion. Cite the resulting entry inline
as [S1](#s1), replacing the ID as appropriate.
The link must point inside the generated article, not to this template.

### S1

**Source type:** <public-document or sanitized-evidence>

**Evidence record:** <S1 in the approved evidence companion; include a relative Markdown link to that file.>

**Title:** <Actual document title or a clearly identified supplied evidence block.>

**Publisher or source role:** <Publisher/organization, engineer report, or tool identity; no personal identifiers.>

**Origin:** <Canonical safe HTTPS document link or approved-evidence:safe-record-id>

**Exact location:** <For public sources use Section: name, Anchor: #name, Page N, or Lines N-M. For sanitized evidence use Lines 1 or Lines 1-N covering the included passage.>

**Version or revision:** <Actual version/update identifier, or Not provided by source.>

**Access:** <Public, approved restricted documentation, or engineer-provided.>

**Verification:** <original-inspected, supplied-excerpt-only, or unavailable.>

**Inspected on:** <Actual inspection date, or Not independently inspected.>

**Supports:** <The specific answer, step, matching criterion, or conclusion supported.>

**Excerpt handling:** <verbatim or redacted>

**Original excerpt:**

> <Short permitted passage copied from the inspected or supplied source; preserve its original language.>

**Interpretation and limits:** <Explain the connection to the claim, scope/version
limits, and any uncertainty. Keep this explanation outside the original quote.>
